basic_profile.bio: A digital artist and gaming enthusiast, I've been exploring games since my childhood days with a GameBoy. Currently residing in Portland, Oregon, I work as a freelance illustrator with a penchant for creating whimsical animal characters. I enjoy unwinding with a good game or diving into the world of trance music. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, and I'm single, enjoying the independence to pursue my hobbies. While I'm not a competitive gamer, I love exploring new game worlds and sharing my thoughts on them.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies mainly in art and gaming, rooted in a Bachelor of Arts degree with a focus on digital media. I've self-taught many aspects of game design through online courses and community workshops. My knowledge of gaming is extensive, particularly in RPGs and indie games, thanks to years of enthusiastic exploration.
